title: Sephora Collection turns 30 and unveils bold innovation strategy for next decade
summary: Sephora Collection, the eponymous line of retailer Sephora, has turned 30 and unveiled a new strategy for growth to mark the occasion. President Sylvia Tournery reveals why a revamp of its face mask collection, a spicules-infused serum, and larger focus on the US and China are all part of the plan
